verdict.rationale: Elicit's core product is built around scholarly literature search: semantic search over papers (elicit-docs-20/27), systematic review workflows for gathering/screening academic papers (elicit-docs-22), and a Research Agent that pulls from publications, public filings, and press releases beyond generic web search (elicit-docs-12). This is well corroborated by hands-on community use for literature overviews (elicit-comm-1). Missing for 10: independent verification of breadth/quality of primary-source coverage, and community reports of accuracy/hallucination issues (elicit-comm-3, elicit-comm-4, elicit-comm-5) suggest results aren't always reliable even though the search-scope capability itself is real.
